look: Rotbloom Matron, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Rotcaps family: cottage-sized fungal mother-flower with drooping spore petals. Family anatomy: waddling mushrooms and fungus-overgrown shamblers with spore gills. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are sickly lilac spore crystal. A softball-sized GKOM core orb, dark crimson with a steady pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, strong stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
